# Hybrid Media

> Using a mix of Marketing and Public Relations to grow your Business

Hybrid Media is a Connecticut communications agency that mixes marketing and public relations: media relations, press coverage, event direction, branding, web development and advertising. Founded by communications strategist Sarah I. Bamford. The website is a single page: the Hybrid Media Press Room, a collection of press coverage earned for the agency's clients.

## Business
- Legal name: Hybrid Media LLC
- Website: https://hybridmediaonline.com/
- Category: Communications agency (marketing + public relations)
- Area served: Connecticut and New York

## Social
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hybridmediacomm
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hybridmediacomm
- X: https://x.com/HybridMediaComm

## Press Room
27 press features across 15 outlets, including Greenwich Time, Patch, Moffly Media, Westfair, Greenwich Sentinel, Greenwich Free Press, WAG Magazine, Modern Luxury, CT Post, CT Insider, CTbites and 203 Local.
Clients covered: I Love Greenwich, Shiki Hibachi & Sushi, La Tazza D'Oro NYC, MOLI, Hinoki, Miku Sushi, Meli-Melo, Bistro V, Wishing Well Pictures, Pro Eyecare, PilatesPrive, La Bocca White Plains NY, Pologeorgis, Pet Pantry Warehouse, Heather Gaudio Fine Art, The Longest Table Stamford, and founder Sarah Bamford.
